purpose: Non-final identity smoke test to determine whether the current built-in imagegen path can use visibly loaded Aachu/Zuv references well enough for final carousel art.

tool_path.name: built_in_image_gen
tool_path.proof_limitation: This mode can prove references were loaded visibly in conversation context, but cannot prove that file paths were passed as explicit image inputs to the image model.

reference_inputs.reason: The rejected smoke test used old flat identity paths. Exact legacy path strings were removed from this archived proof so no downstream generator treats them as active references.

smoke_test_generation.prompt_path: inline built-in imagegen prompt in Codex conversation

qa_result.creator_feedback: faces are still not matching at all
notes: Built-in context generation picked up more identity-specific cues than the rejected carousel images.
Aachu appears substantially closer to selected references, including hair, smile, brows, face shape, and wardrobe cues.
Zuv appears closer than previous carousel outputs, including beard, brows, skin tone, and hair volume, but remains stylized and needs creator judgment before this path can be trusted for finals.
This test still cannot prove explicit image-input delivery because the current built-in image_gen tool exposes only a prompt argument.

final_decision.meaning: Built-in context imagegen failed the creator face-match gate. Do not use this built-in prompt/context path for final Aachu/Zuv artwork. Final generation requires an explicit image-input/edit/API path or remains blocked.

superseded_by_role_based_reference_libra.reason: This proof used older flat identity references for a failed built-in context smoke test. It is retained as historical failure evidence only; exact legacy path strings are intentionally redacted.
